SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, A.PUBLISH_DATE publishDate, FIN.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, A.VAL_DATE valDate, A.VALUATION valuation, '' sevenDayRate, B.TYPE_1 type1/**基金类型**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B ON A.FINPROD_ID =B.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON A.FINPROD_ID =fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1=1
AND a.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND (A.FINPROD_ID LIKE '%' || #{finprodId} || '%' or fin.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE '%' || #{finprodId} || '%')
AND fin.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE '%' || #{fundAbbr} || '%'
AND B.TYPE_1 =#{fundtype}
AND A.VAL_DATE >= to_date(#{valuationStartDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.VAL_DATE <=to_date(#{valuationEndDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
